# reselling_database (Resource)

A managed PostgreSQL or MariaDB server in a VPC. TLS is always required. Logical databases and users are `reselling_database_db` and `reselling_database_user`. Deleting writes a final backup and moves the server to the trash for 48 hours.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "reselling_database_plans" "small" {
  name = "small"
}

resource "reselling_database" "shop" {
  name            = "shop-db"
  engine          = "postgresql"
  version         = "17"
  location_id     = reselling_vpc.backend.location_id
  vpc_id          = reselling_vpc.backend.id
  plan_id         = data.reselling_database_plans.small.plans[0].id
  trusted_sources = ["10.20.0.0/26"]

  public_access  = true
  public_sources = ["203.0.113.10/32"]

  maintenance_day  = 7 # Sunday
  maintenance_hour = 3
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `engine` (String) `postgresql` or `mariadb`.
- `location_id` (String)
- `name` (String) Name. Changed in place.
- `plan_id` (String) Plan. Changed in place; the disk only grows.
- `version` (String) Major version, for example `17` (see `reselling_database_plans`). Major upgrades are not offered.
- `vpc_id` (String) VPC the server is reachable in.

### Optional

- `auto_minor_updates` (Boolean) Install minor versions in the maintenance window.
- `maintenance_day` (Number) 1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday.
- `maintenance_hour` (Number) 0-23, Europe/Berlin.
- `public_access` (Boolean) Open the engine port on a public address (billed). Requires `public_sources` or `public_allow_any`.
- `public_allow_any` (Boolean) Required to allow 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 in `public_sources`.
- `public_ipv6` (Boolean) Also open the port on a public IPv6 address.
- `public_sources` (List of String) Public CIDRs allowed to connect when `public_access` is on (max. 20).
- `storage_class_id` (String) Storage class; the platform picks one when not set.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `trusted_sources` (List of String) CIDRs inside the VPC that may connect (max. 20). The whole VPC may connect when not set.

### Read-Only

- `host` (String) Private address in the VPC.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `port` (Number)
- `public_addresses` (List of String) Public addresses when `public_access` is on.
- `status` (String)

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import reselling_database.shop <database_id>
```
